# dsh-ego-browser

> ego lite browser automation for DeepSeek Harness, with a persistent site-skill
> memory: the agent recalls what it learned about a site before acting, promotes
> a script that worked into a reusable tool in ego's own learnings format, and
> hands the keyboard to the user through a real dsh Continue/Finish prompt when a
> page needs a human.

Package: `@dshworks/dsh-ego-browser` (MIT). Host-only dsh plugin; requires the
ego lite app (macOS) so that `ego-browser` is on the PATH. Not affiliated with
DeepSeek or CitroLabs.

## Tools

- `ego_run(script, url?, taskSpace?, timeoutSeconds?)` — run one JavaScript
  script in ego's runtime. `url` prepends the learned context for that site.
- `ego_recall(url)` — learned notes and tool signatures for a URL, read off disk.
- `ego_site_run(site, tool, kind?, args?)` — call a learned tool; counts the call.
- `ego_learn(site, domains, tool, description, code, callable?, kind?, args?, returns, name?, note?)`
  — promote a working step into a stored site tool.
- `ego_forget(site, tool?)` — remove a tool or a whole site.
- `ego_handoff(taskSpace, reason, instructions?)` — hand control to the user with
  Continue / Finish task, then take it back on Continue.
- `ego_doctor(refresh?)` — installed command, argv shape, helper surface, store
  contents, and an API guide written for the surface actually present.

## Route

- `GET /dsh-ego-browser/memory` — the store as JSON. Loopback plus configured
  `trustedHosts` only.

## Store layout

`<workspace>/learnings/<site-id>/` with `manifest.json`, `notes/*.md`,
`tools/*.js` (node, `export async function f(ctx, args)`), and
`browser-tools/*.js` (evaluated in the page). This is ego lite's own format, so
the store also loads in the stock ego-browser skill outside dsh.

## Facts worth knowing about the ego wire

- The argv shape is not stable: the shipped skill documents
  `ego-browser nodejs <<'EOF'`, while the CLI at citrolabs/ego-lite@main takes no
  argv and exits 2 on a stray `nodejs`. The plugin probes and caches.
- The helper surface is not stable: one generation has flat globals (`cliLog`,
  `snapshotText`, `useOrCreateTaskSpace`), the other has facades (`console.log`,
  `page`, `browser`, `taskSpaces`, `site`). The plugin probes and tells the model.
- On a hard stop (the user takes the task space back) ego discards every line the
  script logged, so a result sentinel never arrives. The plugin reads that
  absence as a takeover, not as a parse failure.
